import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
import json, renewal

def capture():
    out = {}
    def t(name, m, p):
        try:
            r = renewal.process_renewal(m, p)
            out[name] = json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True)
        except Exception as e:
            out[name] = "EXC:" + type(e).__name__ + ":" + str(e)

    base_m = {"id":"u1","status":"active","tier":"gold"}
    base_p = {"amount":90,"method":"card"}

    t("notdict_m", "x", base_p)
    t("notdict_p", base_m, "x")
    t("missing_mid", {"status":"active","tier":"basic"}, base_p)
    t("missing_status", {"id":"u","tier":"basic"}, base_p)
    t("missing_tier", {"id":"u","status":"active"}, base_p)
    t("missing_amount", base_m, {"method":"card"})
    t("missing_method", base_m, {"amount":90})
    t("bad_id_notstr", {"id":3,"status":"active","tier":"basic"}, base_p)
    t("bad_id_empty", {"id":"","status":"active","tier":"basic"}, base_p)
    t("bad_tier_active", {"id":"u","status":"active","tier":"platinum"}, base_p)
    t("bad_amount_active", {"id":"u","status":"active","tier":"basic"}, {"amount":0,"method":"card"})
    t("bad_amount_float", {"id":"u","status":"active","tier":"basic"}, {"amount":40.0,"method":"card"})
    t("bad_method", {"id":"u","status":"active","tier":"basic"}, {"amount":40,"method":"paypal"})
    t("insufficient_active", {"id":"u","status":"active","tier":"gold"}, {"amount":89,"method":"card"})
    t("ok_active_card", {"id":"u","status":"active","tier":"gold"}, {"amount":90,"method":"card"})
    t("ok_active_xfer", {"id":"u","status":"active","tier":"basic"}, {"amount":50,"method":"transfer"})

    t("banned", {"id":"u","status":"banned"}, base_p)
    t("banned_missing_tier", {"id":"u","status":"banned"}, base_p)

    def lm(d): return {"id":"u","status":"lapsed","tier":"gold","expired_days":d}
    t("lapsed_bad_expiry", {"id":"u","status":"lapsed","tier":"gold"}, base_p)
    t("lapsed_exp_neg", lm(-1), base_p)
    t("lapsed_exp_float", {"id":"u","status":"lapsed","tier":"gold","expired_days":1.5}, base_p)
    t("lapsed_bad_tier", {"id":"u","status":"lapsed","tier":"x","expired_days":1}, base_p)
    t("lapsed_insufficient", lm(5), {"amount":90,"method":"card"})
    t("lapsed_grace_card", lm(5), {"amount":120,"method":"card"})
    t("lapsed_grace_xfer", lm(30), {"amount":105,"method":"transfer"})
    t("lapsed_reinstate", lm(31), {"amount":200,"method":"card"})

    def sm(s): return {"id":"u","status":"suspended","tier":"basic","strikes":s}
    t("susp_bad_strikes", {"id":"u","status":"suspended","tier":"basic"}, base_p)
    t("susp_neg", sm(-1), base_p)
    t("susp_float", {"id":"u","status":"suspended","tier":"basic","strikes":1.5}, base_p)
    t("susp_bad_tier", {"id":"u","status":"suspended","tier":"x","strikes":1}, base_p)
    t("susp_max", sm(3), {"amount":999,"method":"card"})
    t("susp_over", sm(5), {"amount":999,"method":"card"})
    t("susp_insufficient", sm(1), {"amount":50,"method":"card"})
    t("susp_ok_card", sm(1), {"amount":60,"method":"card"})
    t("susp_ok_xfer", sm(2), {"amount":60,"method":"transfer"})

    t("unknown_status", {"id":"u","status":"mystery"}, base_p)
    return out

with open("playground/behavior_before.json","w") as f:
    json.dump(capture(), f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
print("captured")
